root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic axes: restraint or reduction, and freshness or tenderness.
root_idea.development: The restraint axis extends from lowering the gaze or voice to diminishing quantities and curbing actions; the other axis describes things that are fresh, tender, moist, flourishing, or newly emerged.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The group represents the Quran-attested Form I verb, normalized to its Classical Arabic perfect citation form غَضَّ.

senses.definition: To lower, restrain, or reduce one’s gaze.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with the eyes or gaze; in the Quranic construction with مِنْ, it denotes limiting or turning the gaze away from what is prohibited. It may involve contracting the eyelids or directing the eyes downward.

senses.definition: To lower or diminish the loudness of one’s voice.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with صَوْتٌ or مِنْ صَوْتٍ; the construction denotes reducing vocal loudness rather than necessarily becoming silent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contract the eyelids, blink, or look downward or languidly; sometimes, to display abasement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical or expressive use concerning the eyes, distinct from the Quranic injunction to restrain the gaze.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bear disagreeable or hateful matters with forgiveness and silence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of restraining or withholding a response.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower a horse’s rein.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action is performed to lessen the horse’s sharpness of temper.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower someone’s estimation, dignity, or rank; to disparage or charge someone with a fault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْهُ for diminution of another person’s standing or reputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disdain or scorn something or someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use expressing contempt or disdain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lessen, diminish, shorten, or deprive of part.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May concern the contents of a vessel, water, hair, or another person’s due; the object need not belong to a particular class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break a branch, stick, or similar object without breaking it completely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes incomplete breaking rather than total destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold, restrain, or prevent something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used broadly with an object; in an address to a rider, it can mean to restrain the mount and pause for a while.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become fresh, juicy, moist, flourishing, or beautiful and bright.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing freshness, luxuriance, or renewed beauty; of skin, it can denote fineness or delicacy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat the tender emerging spadix of a palm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the fresh palm spadix known as غَضّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become fine-skinned, plump, soft, or tender; also to become languid or abased.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form II use describing bodily softness or a state of languor and abasement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the eye or eyes to become contracted, and possibly closed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported comparison is with becoming closed; the more specific interpretation is contraction of the eye or eyes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For water, a sea, or a great river to become scanty, decrease, sink away, or disappear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes diminution or disappearance of a quantity, especially water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Indistinct or unclear speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun describing the manner of speaking rather than the content of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The boiling of a cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional noun for the pot’s boiling activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decrease, diminish, become deficient, or lose something of its amount or integrity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In negative constructions, it can mean to remain undiminished or unimpaired; it is also used of rain that does not cease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh, juicy, sappy, moist, tender, flourishing, beautiful, or bright.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied broadly to things, including fresh plants or shade untouched by the sun; it can describe something unchanged for the worse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A recently born calf.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is reported as غِضَاضٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The emerging or tender spadix of a palm, or its fruit when newly formed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for the fresh early growth of the palm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sufficiency of the means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independent nominal use, comparable to having enough provision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an eye or eyes: lowered, contracted, directed downward, or languishing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective can describe the appearance of the eyelids and gaze, including a languishing look.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Faithful and not treacherous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic interpretation of the expression غَضِيضُ الطَّرْفِ نَقِيُّ الظَّرْفِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lowered or diminished in estimation; defective, deficient, low, mean, or vile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival result of diminution in quality, rank, or worth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lessened, diminished, defective, or deficient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general adjectival description of something reduced in amount or completeness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A defect, imperfection, fault, vice, lowness, or want of power.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a deficiency or humiliating shortcoming attributed to a person or matter.
